description_en: Queries the information about the execution of remediation templates
name: ListRemediations

parameters.help_en:
The rule IDs. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 资源列表的页码。起始值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 修正列表的页码。起始值：1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~50

Remediations.description_en: The converted configuration of the remediation template. This parameter is returned only for an OOS remediation template

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource belongs

InvokeType.description_en:
The execution mode of the remediation template. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation template was not executed.
AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation template was automatically executed.
MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation template was manually executed.
NOT_CONFIG: The execution mode was not specified
InvokeType.description_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：
NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置

LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_en: The ID of the last successful execution of the remediation template
LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的ID

LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last successful execution of the remediation template Unit: milliseconds
LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的时间戳。单位：毫秒

LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_en:
The mode of the last successful execution of the remediation template. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation template was not executed.
AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation template was automatically executed.
MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation template was manually executed.
NOT_CONFIG: The execution mode was not specified
LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_zh:
修正最近一次执行成功的方式。取值：

NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置

RemediationId.description_en: The ID of the remediation template

RemediationOriginParams.description_en: The converted configuration of the remediation template. This parameter is available only for an OOS remediation template
RemediationOriginParams.description_zh: 修正设置参数的转换格式。仅用于转换OOS模板的参数

RemediationSourceType.description_en:
The source of remediation. Valid values:

ALIYUN: official template.
CUSTOM: custom template.
NONE: none
RemediationSourceType.description_zh:
执行修正的模板来源。取值：

ALIYUN：官网模板。
CUSTOM：自定义模板。
NONE：无

RemediationTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the remediation template

RemediationType.description_en:
The type of the remediation template. Valid values:

OOS: Operation Orchestration Service (official remediation)
FC: Function Compute (custom remediation)
RemediationType.description_zh:
修正类型。取值：

OOS：运维编排（官方修正）。

FC：函数计算（自定义修正）

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of remediation settings
